description: Na₄TiInSi₂PO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-3.00 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.81 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-3.03 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.69 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.13 Å. In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.26 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-40°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-39°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.68 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-39°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one In, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one In, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one In, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃InSi trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃TiSi trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃TiSi trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃InSi trigonal bipyramid. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one In, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃InSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₃TiSi trigonal bipyramids and  a faceface with one ONa₃InSi trigonal bipyramid. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one In, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ti, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Ti, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃TiSi trigonal bipyramids.
